title: A separate lab app
author: claude
summary: We created a small app of our own for lighting experiments, instead of working inside the configurator.
what:
We created `render-lab`: its own folder and git repository with a minimal app.
It copies the table's look from the configurator, so we can work on lighting and rendering without the configurator's screens.
why: The configurator is big. A clean lab makes lighting experiments quick, and keeps the room work apart until it is ready to move back.
how:
- The lab uses the same versions of its main tools as the configurator, so code can move back easily.
- Two helper files were copied over unchanged.
- Start it with `npm run dev`; check the code for mistakes with `npm run typecheck`.
next: Move the finished room and table lighting back into the configurator (`Room.tsx` and `Env.tsx` in `demo-bemade`).
